"""Point-in-time (PIT) fundamentals for Korean listed companies - keyless."""
from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import io
import re
import time
import zipfile
from datetime import date

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import requests
from lxml import etree

from quantcio.data.http import PoliteSession  # per-host throttle: dart 0.5s, opendart 0.2s
from quantcio.data.kr import parse_dart_search, parse_dart_viewer_nodes

OPENDART_WEB = "https://opendart.fss.or.kr"
OPENDART_API = "https://opendart.fss.or.kr/api"
DART_WEB = "https://dart.fss.or.kr"
BULK_PERIOD = {"FQ": "1분기보고서", "HY": "반기보고서", "TQ": "3분기보고서", "FY": "사업보고서"}
_META = ["재무제표종류", "종목코드", "회사명", "시장구분", "업종", "업종명", "결산월", "결산기준일", "보고서종류",
         "통화", "항목코드", "항목명"]


def bulk_file_list(session: requests.Session) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """All bulk zips -> [bsn_yr:int, period:FQ|HY|TQ|FY, stmt:BS|PL|CF|CE, fl_nm, built:Timestamp]."""
    r = session.post(f"{OPENDART_WEB}/disclosureinfo/fnltt/dwld/list.do", data={},
                     headers={"X-Requested-With": "XMLHttpRequest",
                              "Referer": f"{OPENDART_WEB}/disclosureinfo/fnltt/dwld/main.do"}, timeout=30)
    r.raise_for_status()
    rows = re.findall(r"download_ext002\('(\d{4})',\s*'(\w+)',\s*'(\w+)',\s*'([^']+\.zip)'\)", r.text)
    if not rows:
        raise ValueError("OpenDART bulk list: no download_ext002(...) entries (page changed?)")
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["bsn_yr", "period", "stmt", "fl_nm"])
    df["bsn_yr"] = df["bsn_yr"].astype(int)
    df["built"] = pd.to_datetime(df["fl_nm"].str.extract(r"_(\d{14})\.zip$")[0], format="%Y%m%d%H%M%S")
    return df


def fetch_bulk_zip(session: requests.Session, fl_nm: str) -> bytes:
    r = session.get(f"{OPENDART_WEB}/cmm/downloadFnlttZip.do", params={"fl_nm": fl_nm}, timeout=300)
    r.raise_for_status()
    if r.content[:2] != b"PK":
        raise ValueError(f"bulk {fl_nm}: not a zip ({r.headers.get('Content-Type')}, {len(r.content)} B)")
    return r.content


def _num(s: str) -> float | None:
    s = (s or "").strip().replace(",", "")
    if not s or s == "-":
        return None
    try:
        return float(s)
    except ValueError:
        return None


def read_bulk_zip(content: bytes) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """cp949 member names (no zip utf-8 flag), cp949 TSV, header interleaves EMPTY separator columns
    ('', '당기', '', '', '전기', '전전기', '') -> read values by header POSITION."""
    out = []
    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(content)) as z:
        for info in z.infolist():
            name = info.filename if info.flag_bits & 0x800 else info.filename.encode("cp437").decode("cp949")
            rdr = csv.reader(io.StringIO(z.read(info).decode("cp949", errors="replace")), delimiter="\t",
                             quoting=csv.QUOTE_NONE)
            header = [c.strip() for c in next(rdr)]
            vcols = [(k, c) for k, c in enumerate(header) if k >= 12 and c]
            recs = []
            for row in rdr:
                if len(row) < 12:
                    continue
                meta = [c.strip() for c in row[:12]]
                for k, c in vcols:
                    v = _num(row[k]) if k < len(row) else None
                    if v is not None:
                        recs.append((*meta, c, v))
            if recs:
                df = pd.DataFrame(recs, columns=[*_META, "col", "value"])
                df.insert(0, "member", name)
                out.append(df)
    df = pd.concat(out, ignore_index=True)
    df["stock_code"] = df["종목코드"].str.strip("[]")
    df["period_end"] = pd.to_datetime(df["결산기준일"], errors="coerce")
    df["consolidated"] = df["member"].str.contains("_연결_")
    return df.drop(columns=["종목코드", "결산기준일", "업종", "업종명"])


KEY_ITEMS = {
    "revenue": ["Revenue"], "op_income": ["OperatingIncomeLoss"], "ni": ["ProfitLoss"],
    "ni_parent": ["ProfitLossAttributableToOwnersOfParent"], "eps": ["BasicEarningsLossPerShare"],
    "assets": ["Assets"], "liabilities": ["Liabilities"], "equity": ["Equity"],
    "equity_parent": ["EquityAttributableToOwnersOfParent"], "nci_equity": ["NoncontrollingInterests"],
    "cfo": ["CashFlowsFromUsedInOperatingActivities"],
}
_FLOW = {"revenue", "op_income", "ni", "ni_parent", "eps", "cfo"}
LABEL_FALLBACK = {  # only when no standard concept exists (company-extension codes, e.g. 이마트 CFO 2018-2021)
    "revenue": r"^(매출액|수익\(매출액\)|영업수익|매출)$",
    "op_income": r"^영업이익(\(손실\))?$",
    "cfo": r"^영업활동(으로인한|으로부터의|으로부터|에서의|의)?(순)?현금(흐름|유입|유출|유입\(유출\)|흐름합계)?$",
}
_STD = re.compile(r"^(?:ifrs-full|ifrs|dart)_(.+)$")


def extract_key_items(long: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """-> one row per (stock_code, period_end, 보고서종류): <item> (FY / BS end / Q: YTD), <item>_3m (Q reports), fs."""
    df = long[long["col"].str.startswith("당기")].copy()
    df["std"] = df["항목코드"].str.extract(_STD)[0]
    df["is_3m"] = df["col"].str.endswith("3개월")
    is_end = df["col"].str.endswith("말")
    is_flow_item = df["std"].isin([c for i in _FLOW for c in KEY_ITEMS[i]])
    df["crank"] = np.where(is_flow_item, np.where(is_end, 2, 0), np.where(is_end | df["col"].eq("당기"), 0, 2))
    has_cfs = df.groupby(["stock_code", "period_end", "보고서종류"])["consolidated"].transform("any")
    df = df[df["consolidated"] == has_cfs]
    df["mrank"] = np.where(df["member"].str.contains("_02_"), 0, 1)  # 손익계산서 before 포괄손익계산서
    df = df.sort_values(["crank", "mrank"], kind="stable")
    keys = ["stock_code", "period_end", "보고서종류"]
    out = df.groupby(keys).agg(fs=("consolidated", lambda s: "CFS" if s.iloc[0] else "OFS"),
                               name=("회사명", "first"), market=("시장구분", "first"))
    for item, concepts in KEY_ITEMS.items():
        x = df[df["std"].isin(concepts)]
        for suffix, part in [("", x[~x["is_3m"]]), ("_3m", x[x["is_3m"]])]:
            if suffix and item not in _FLOW:
                continue
            out[item + suffix] = part.groupby(keys)["value"].first()
    label = df["항목명"].str.replace(r"\s+", "", regex=True)
    for item, pat in LABEL_FALLBACK.items():
        hit = df[df["std"].isna() & label.str.match(pat) & ~df["is_3m"]]
        out[item] = out[item].fillna(hit.groupby(keys)["value"].first())
    eps_parts = df[df["std"].isin(["BasicEarningsLossPerShareFromContinuingOperations",
                                   "BasicEarningsLossPerShareFromDiscontinuedOperations"]) & ~df["is_3m"]]
    out["eps"] = out["eps"].fillna(eps_parts.groupby(keys + ["std"])["value"].first().groupby(level=keys).sum())
    ext = df[df["항목코드"].str.endswith("_ProfitLossAttributableToOwnersOfParent") & df["std"].isna()]
    out["ni_parent"] = out["ni_parent"].fillna(ext[~ext["is_3m"]].groupby(keys)["value"].sum())  # NAVER 2021
    nci_flow = df[df["std"].eq("ProfitLossAttributableToNoncontrollingInterests")].groupby(keys).size()
    no_nci = ~out.index.isin(nci_flow.index) & out["nci_equity"].isna()
    out.loc[no_nci, "ni_parent"] = out.loc[no_nci, "ni_parent"].fillna(out.loc[no_nci, "ni"])
    out.loc[no_nci, "ni_parent_3m"] = out.loc[no_nci, "ni_parent_3m"].fillna(out.loc[no_nci, "ni_3m"])
    out.loc[no_nci, "equity_parent"] = out.loc[no_nci, "equity_parent"].fillna(out.loc[no_nci, "equity"])
    return out.reset_index()


def quarterly_standalone(items: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Q1..Q3 = '3개월' column, Q4 = FY - 3Q YTD; cfo_q from consecutive YTD differences (CF is YTD-only)."""
    order = {"1분기보고서": 1, "반기보고서": 2, "3분기보고서": 3, "사업보고서": 4}
    df = items.copy()
    df["fq"] = df["보고서종류"].map(order)
    df = df.sort_values(["stock_code", "period_end"])
    for f in ["revenue", "op_income", "ni", "ni_parent", "cfo"]:
        q = df[f + "_3m"] if f + "_3m" in df else pd.Series(np.nan, index=df.index)
        prev_ytd = df.groupby("stock_code")[f].shift(1)
        prev_is_q3 = df.groupby("stock_code")["fq"].shift(1).eq(3)
        gap_ok = (df["period_end"] - df.groupby("stock_code")["period_end"].shift(1)).dt.days.between(80, 100)
        q4 = (df[f] - prev_ytd).where(df["fq"].eq(4) & prev_is_q3 & gap_ok)
        df[f + "_q"] = q.where(df["fq"].lt(4), q4)
        if f == "cfo":
            prev = df.groupby("stock_code")[f].shift(1)
            df["cfo_q"] = np.where(df["fq"].eq(1), df[f], (df[f] - prev).where(gap_ok))
    return df

_PERIODIC_TYPES = ["A001", "A002", "A003"]  # 사업 / 반기 / 분기보고서
_PERIOD_RE = re.compile(r"(사업보고서|반기보고서|분기보고서)\s*\((\d{4})\.(\d{2})\)")
BULK_TO_DART_KIND = {"1분기보고서": "분기보고서", "3분기보고서": "분기보고서", "반기보고서": "반기보고서",
                     "사업보고서": "사업보고서"}


def _post_retry(session, url, *, data, headers, tries=4):
    """Transient failures only. A DART IP block (TLS ok, then RemoteDisconnected on every request) is NOT fixed by
    retries: stop, persist progress, resume later, keep the sustained rate <= 10 requests/min."""
    for k in range(tries):
        try:
            r = session.post(url, data=data, headers=headers, timeout=30)
            r.raise_for_status()
            return r
        except (requests.ConnectionError, requests.Timeout):
            if k == tries - 1:
                raise
            time.sleep(2.0 * 2**k)
    raise AssertionError("unreachable")


def _windows(start: date, end: date, years: int = 5):
    """DART web search silently returns '조회 결과가 없습니다' when the range exceeds 10 years
    (20150101-20250101 OK, 20150101-20250102 empty)."""
    out, s = [], start
    while s <= end:
        e = min(end, (pd.Timestamp(s) + pd.DateOffset(years=years) - pd.Timedelta(days=1)).date())
        out.append((s, e))
        s = e + pd.Timedelta(days=1).to_pytimedelta()
    return out


def dart_periodic_filings(session, stock_code: str, start: date, end: date, types=None, max_pages=20) -> list[dict]:
    rows = []
    for ws, we in _windows(start, end):
        page, n_pages = 1, 1
        while page <= min(n_pages, max_pages):
            form = {"currentPage": str(page), "maxResults": "100", "maxLinks": "10", "sort": "date",
                    "series": "desc", "startDate": ws.strftime("%Y%m%d"), "endDate": we.strftime("%Y%m%d"),
                    "option": "corp", "textCrpNm": stock_code, "textCrpCik": "",
                    "publicType": types or _PERIODIC_TYPES}
            r = _post_retry(session, f"{DART_WEB}/dsab007/detailSearch.ax", data=form,
                            headers={"Referer": f"{DART_WEB}/dsab007/main.do", "X-Requested-With": "XMLHttpRequest"})
            part, n_pages = parse_dart_search(r.text)
            if page == 1 and not part and "조회 결과가 없습니다" not in r.text:
                raise ValueError(f"DART search {stock_code}: unparsable result page")
            rows += part
            page += 1
        if n_pages > max_pages:
            raise RuntimeError(f"DART search {stock_code} {ws}..{we}: truncated at {max_pages}/{n_pages} pages")
    return list({r["rcept_no"]: r for r in rows}.values())


def publication_table(rows: list[dict]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    recs = []
    for r in rows:
        m = _PERIOD_RE.search(r["report_nm"] or "")
        if not m:
            continue
        recs.append({"kind": m.group(1),
                     "period_end": pd.Timestamp(int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(3)), 1) + pd.offsets.MonthEnd(0),
                     "rcept_dt": pd.Timestamp(r["rcept_dt"]), "rcept_no": r["rcept_no"],
                     "is_correction": r["report_nm"].lstrip().startswith("[")})
    cols = ["kind", "period_end", "first_rcept_dt", "first_rcept_no", "orig_rcept_dt", "last_rcept_dt",
            "last_rcept_no", "n_filings"]
    if not recs:
        return pd.DataFrame(columns=cols)
    df = pd.DataFrame(recs).sort_values(["rcept_dt", "rcept_no"])
    g = df.groupby(["kind", "period_end"])
    out = g.agg(first_rcept_dt=("rcept_dt", "first"), first_rcept_no=("rcept_no", "first"),
                last_rcept_dt=("rcept_dt", "last"), last_rcept_no=("rcept_no", "last"), n_filings=("rcept_no", "size"))
    out["orig_rcept_dt"] = df[~df["is_correction"]].groupby(["kind", "period_end"])["rcept_dt"].first()
    return out.reset_index()[cols]

working.name: Conservative lag rule and PIT panel assembly (available_from, build_pit_panel, asof)
working.purpose: Converts rcept_dt into the first KRX session on which a period's values may be used. Provides a fallback rule when the date is unknown, restatement flags, and an as-of snapshot for backtests.
working.verified_code:
def next_session_after(d, sessions: pd.DatetimeIndex):
    i = sessions.searchsorted(pd.Timestamp(d).normalize(), side="right")
    return sessions[i] if i < len(sessions) else pd.NaT


def available_from(period_end, kind, rcept_dt, sessions, fallback_days=(60, 120)):
    """-> (first session usable, 'rcept'|'lag_rule'). Filings land until ~18:00 KST (after the 15:30 close)."""
    if rcept_dt is not None and not pd.isna(rcept_dt):
        return next_session_after(rcept_dt, sessions), "rcept"
    days = fallback_days[1] if kind == "사업보고서" else fallback_days[0]
    d = pd.Timestamp(period_end) + pd.Timedelta(days=days)
    i = sessions.searchsorted(d)                      # roll weekend/holiday deadline forward
    d = sessions[i] if i < len(sessions) else d
    return next_session_after(d, sessions), "lag_rule"  # usable the session after


def build_pit_panel(items, pubs, sessions):
    df = items.copy()
    df["kind"] = df["보고서종류"].map(BULK_TO_DART_KIND)
    df = df.merge(pubs, on=["stock_code", "kind", "period_end"], how="left")
    res = [available_from(p, k, r, sessions) for p, k, r in zip(df["period_end"], df["kind"], df["first_rcept_dt"])]
    df["available_from"] = [a for a, _ in res]
    df["date_source"] = [s for _, s in res]
    df["restated_later"] = df["last_rcept_dt"].gt(df["first_rcept_dt"])
    df["latest_version_from"] = [next_session_after(d, sessions) if not pd.isna(d) else pd.NaT for d in df["last_rcept_dt"]]
    return df


def asof(panel, when, strict_restatements=True):
    when = pd.Timestamp(when)
    usable = panel["available_from"].le(when)
    if strict_restatements:
        usable &= ~panel["restated_later"].fillna(False) | panel["latest_version_from"].le(when)
    x = panel[usable].sort_values(["stock_code", "period_end", "available_from"])
    return x.groupby("stock_code").tail(1)

probe.recommended_design:
1) VALUES. Use the OpenDART bulk zips (BS, PL, CF) for FY2015 and 2016Q1 onward for all KOSPI/KOSDAQ filers, including later-delisted companies. Pipeline: bulk_file_list, then fetch_bulk_zip, read_bulk_zip, extract_key_items, quarterly_standalone. Key the result by (stock_code, period_end, 보고서종류). Use consolidated statements if the company filed any for that report, else separate. Take flows from the YTD columns, with 3-month columns for Q1-Q3 and Q4 = FY minus Q3 YTD. Store everything as-reported (EPS is not split-adjusted). Do not rely on EPS/BPS for valuation. Compute PER = market cap / TTM ni_parent and PBR = market cap / equity_parent, where market cap = unadjusted close x shares at t from the universe area. Share counts do not exist in any keyless historical source except WiseReport's 5 years; with a key, use stockTotqySttus.

2) PUBLICATION DATE. For every stock code in the PIT universe, fetch the DART web periodic filings (A001-A003) in 10-year windows or less, run publication_table, and set available_from = the first KRX session strictly after the ORIGINAL report's rcept_dt. When the date is unknown, use period_end + 60 days (quarter or half) / + 120 days (annual), rolled to a KRX session, then the next session. Measured: 0 of 2,458 too early over 2014-2026 and 1 of 1,677 over 2019-2025 (a distressed filer at 115 days), at a mean cost of 14 to 15 sessions of staleness. Do NOT use +45/+90 calendar days. The repo's current build_valuation_history pattern is at least one session early in 73 to 76% of company-periods (max 44 sessions), and even +45/+90 rolled to a business day then the next session is early 1.8 to 3.6% of the time (foreign issuers with 60/120-day deadlines and distressed filers). With DART_API_KEY, replace the web search with list.json (corp_code, pblntf_ty=A, last_reprt_at=N), which avoids the web IP block.

3) RESTATEMENTS. The bulk carries the latest corrected values. Flag restated_later (a correction filed on a later date than the first filing): 12% of company-periods in the sample, with 9.2% corrected more than 7 days after the original. For those periods, fetch the ORIGINAL XBRL (dart_filing_xbrl keyless, or opendart_xbrl with a key). Use the original values from available_from until the correction's next session, and the bulk (latest) values after that. If you cannot afford the fetches, the conservative fallback asof(strict_restatements=True) removes look-ahead but leaves 6.1% of company-months stale (median 1 quarter, p90 12 quarters).

4) GAPS. Build the bulk key set and the DART filing list, and diff them. Missing listed non-financial periods (about 1%, e.g. 이마트 FY2023, CJ대한통운 FY2024) are filled from per-filing XBRL. Financial companies before 2023Q3 have no XBRL anywhere keyless: exclude the financial sector from fundamental factors before 2023Q3, or handle it separately. KONEX is out of scope (not in the bulk).

5) UNIVERSE LINK. Use the universe area's PIT membership (KIND listing plus delisted list). The bulk 시장구분 is PIT as filed and can cross-check it. Drop 기타법인 rows.

Residual biases and how to measure them:
(a) Restatement look-ahead if step 3 is skipped. The estimate is 12% of periods restated later x 13.6% (6 of 44) with key items changed by more than 1%, i.e. about 1.6% of company-periods. Measure it by fetching original XBRL for a random 200 restated_later periods and comparing factor ranks under original and latest values.
(b) Timing conservatism, not look-ahead. 잠정실적, 손익구조변동 and 감사보고서제출 publish P&L earlier for 86% of annual periods (median 38 days) and about 46% of quarters (median 14 to 16 days). Measure the alpha decay by re-running the backtest with release dates for P&L items (parse I002 영업(잠정)실적 bodies with the kr-text tools).
(c) Coverage bias. Financials are missing before 2023Q3, as are KONEX and PDF-only filers. Measure it as the share of universe market cap per date that has fundamentals: non-financial survivors are covered 98.6 to 99.8% per FY.
(d) Item-mapping drift. Company-extension XBRL codes (NAVER 2021 parent NI, 이마트 CFO) are handled by fallbacks, but ni_parent coverage is 93.2% and EPS about 95%. Track the null rate per item and FY, and cross-check a monthly sample against WiseReport; currently 92.9% agree within 0.1% and the differences are WiseReport restatements.
(e) Bulk rebuilds change values over time. Archive every build (old file names stay downloadable) and diff the vintages.

No blocking was observed on opendart after more than 300 requests.

Publication dates (keyless, dart.fss.or.kr): 3,085 codes x 2 requests with 10-year windows (for example 2015-01-01..2024-12-31 and 2025-01-01..today) is about 6,200 POSTs of about 45 KB each (about 280 MB). The 3-window variant is about 9,300 POSTs. DART blocked the IP after 696 requests in 34 minutes, so budget 10 requests/min or less: 6,200 requests take about 10.3 hours, and should be spread over 2 or more sessions with a resumable cache. With DART_API_KEY: corpCode.xml (1 call) plus list.json per corp_code (1 to 2 calls, page_count=100), about 3,100 to 6,200 calls, under 1 hour and within the 20,000/day limit.

Original XBRL for restated periods: about 12% of 96,687 company-periods is about 11,600 filings. Keyless that is 2 DART requests each (main.do plus ifrs.do), about 23,000 requests, which at 10/min is about 39 hours and impractical. With a key, fnlttXbrl.xml is about 11,600 calls (1 day of quota). Zips are 0.1 to 1.3 MB (average about 0.3 MB), so about 3.5 GB total; parse and keep only the key items. The minimum useful subset is corrections filed more than 7 days after the original (9.2%, about 8,900 filings).

Gap fill for listed non-financial periods missing from the bulk: about 1%, i.e. about 900 filings x 2 requests, about 1,800 DART requests (about 3 hours at 10/min).

Financials before 2023Q3 (about 60 to 70 listed companies x about 30 periods, about 2,000 company-periods): not available keyless. Grand total keyless: about 5 minutes for values plus about 10 to 15 hours of throttled DART web for dates and gap fill. With a key: under 2 hours.
gotchas: Bulk values are the LATEST corrected version, not as-first-reported. Celltrion FY2018 in the bulk shows OP 323.13B (the 2022-05-12 correction) versus 338.69B published on 2019-04-01. Using bulk values from the original filing date leaks restatements.

The bulk TSV header interleaves empty separator columns ('', '당기', '', '', '전기', '전전기', ''). Compacting the header shifts labels, so read by position. Member file names are cp949 without the zip UTF-8 flag (filename.encode('cp437').decode('cp949')); the text is cp949.

Bulk value-column names vary by file and year: '당기', '당기 반기 3개월', '당기 반기 누적', '당기 반기말', '당기반기', '당기 3분기', '당기3분기', '당기 3분기말'. Flows must prefer YTD ('누적' or the bare period) and balance-sheet items '...말'. 항목코드 prefixes changed from ifrs_ (up to about FY2018) to ifrs-full_ (later); dart_OperatingIncomeLoss is used throughout.

Some companies file key lines under company-extension codes: NAVER FY2021 parent NI appears as two 'entity00266961_udf_..._ProfitLossAttributableToOwnersOfParent' lines (continuing 1.49조 plus discontinued 15.0조, total 16.49조 = WiseReport), and 이마트 CFO as '..._StatementOfCashFlowsAbstract'. EPS is sometimes reported only as FromContinuing plus FromDiscontinued. The module's fallbacks handle these.

Bulk EPS is as-reported and not split-adjusted, while Naver fchart prices are split- and rights-adjusted. Mixing them breaks PER (리노공업 x4.02, 에코프로비엠 x4.07 in 2021). Compute valuation from market cap and aggregate NI or equity.

Financial companies (banks, insurers, securities, card and capital firms) are absent from the bulk and have no XBRL download before 2023Q3; from 2023 TQ they appear in separate 금융기타/보험/은행/증권 member files. Banks have no Revenue line (use op_income or ni).
The bulk includes 기타법인 (unlisted major filers, even stock_code 'null' for GS에너지) and excludes KONEX. Filter by the PIT universe. 시장구분 is PIT as filed (Celltrion 코스닥 until 2017-09 then 유가).

Bulk files are rebuilt irregularly and the timestamp in the name changes (2026_1Q files were rebuilt on 2026-09-25 at 00:23-07:04, during this probe), so always call list.do first. Old names remain downloadable; archive them for vintages.

DART web search: ranges over 10 years silently return '조회 결과가 없습니다'. publicType must be sent as repeated form keys. corporationType filters by the CURRENT class. Search by stock code in textCrpNm (works for delisted codes).

DART web blocks the IP after about 700 requests in 34 minutes at 0.5 s spacing: TLS completes, then RemoteDisconnected (curl HTTP 000) on every request, still at 14 or more minutes. PoliteSession's urllib3 retry does not cover POST. Plan at most 10 requests/min, persist progress, and use OpenDART list.json with a key when available.

Statutory deadlines roll to the next business day. 22.9% of filings came after a naive +45/+90 calendar deadline, mostly by 1 to 3 days, and 70 to 84% of companies file ON the rolled deadline day. Filings can land after the 15:30 close (rcept_dt is date-only), so data is usable from the NEXT session only.

Leap years: Dec 31 + 90 days is Mar 30 (2020, 2024), and the FY2023 naive deadline 2024-03-30 was a Saturday. Foreign issuers (950xxx, e.g. JTC 950170) have 60-day quarterly and 120-day annual deadlines, and 이지케어텍 filed quarterlies at 60 days. That is why the fallback lag must be +60/+120 rather than +45/+90.

Distressed and delisting candidates file late (웅진에너지 and 050540 FY2020 on 2021-04-07; 019590 반기 at 115 days) or never. Actual rcept dates matter most exactly where survivorship-free backtests are sensitive.

About 14% of periodic reports have [기재정정] corrections (median 57 days later, up to 6.3 years). Most do not change the numbers (38 of 44 identical), but 13.6% change key items by more than 1% and up to 5x for distressed filers.

WiseReport, Naver and FnGuide serve only currently listed companies, 3 to 5 years deep, with adjusted or restated values. They are useful only for validation. WiseReport redirects an invalid or delisted code to Samsung via a JS alert. FnGuide wcomp ignores gicode= and silently shows Samsung.

The DART per-filing download (ifrs.do / excel.do) returns HTTP 200 with 0 bytes unless Referer is the pdf/download/main.do?rcp_no&dcm_no URL. dcm_no is the first node's dcmNo from dsaf001/main.do (kr.py parse_dart_viewer_nodes). Use lxml recover=True because some XBRL files have invalid namespace URIs.

잠정실적 and 손익구조변동 publish P&L 2 to 7 weeks before the periodic report for most large caps (97% file 잠정실적) but rarely for small caps (9%). Using periodic-report dates is look-ahead-free but understates information speed differently across size buckets.

# Patched functions in kr_pit_fundamentals_fixed.py (all other entry code unchanged; imports, KEY_ITEMS, _FLOW, LABEL_FALLBACK, _STD as in the original)
def extract_key_items(long: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = long[long["col"].str.startswith("당기")].copy()
    df["std"] = df["항목코드"].str.extract(_STD)[0]
    df["is_3m"] = df["col"].str.endswith("3개월")
    is_end = df["col"].str.endswith("말")
    is_flow_item = df["std"].isin([c for i in _FLOW for c in KEY_ITEMS[i]])
    df["crank"] = np.where(is_flow_item, np.where(is_end, 2, 0), np.where(is_end | df["col"].eq("당기"), 0, 2))
    has_cfs = df.groupby(["stock_code", "period_end", "보고서종류"])["consolidated"].transform("any")
    df = df[df["consolidated"] == has_cfs]
    df["mrank"] = np.where(df["member"].str.contains("_02_"), 0, 1)
    df = df.sort_values(["crank", "mrank"], kind="stable")
    keys = ["stock_code", "period_end", "보고서종류"]
    out = df.groupby(keys).agg(fs=("consolidated", lambda s: "CFS" if s.iloc[0] else "OFS"),
                               name=("회사명", "first"), market=("시장구분", "first"),
                               currency=("통화", "first"), fy_month=("결산월", "first"))   # FIX: non-KRW filers
    for item, concepts in KEY_ITEMS.items():
        x = df[df["std"].isin(concepts)]
        for suffix, part in [("", x[~x["is_3m"]]), ("_3m", x[x["is_3m"]])]:
            if suffix and item not in _FLOW:
                continue
            out[item + suffix] = part.groupby(keys)["value"].first()
    label = df["항목명"].str.replace(r"\s+", "", regex=True)
    for item, pat in LABEL_FALLBACK.items():
        hit = df[df["std"].isna() & label.str.match(pat) & ~df["is_3m"]]
        out[item] = out[item].fillna(hit.groupby(keys)["value"].first())
    eps_parts = df[df["std"].isin(["BasicEarningsLossPerShareFromContinuingOperations",
                                   "BasicEarningsLossPerShareFromDiscontinuedOperations"]) & ~df["is_3m"]]
    out["eps"] = out["eps"].fillna(eps_parts.groupby(keys + ["std"])["value"].first().groupby(level=keys).sum())
    ext = df[df["항목코드"].str.endswith("_ProfitLossAttributableToOwnersOfParent") & df["std"].isna()]
    out["ni_parent"] = out["ni_parent"].fillna(ext[~ext["is_3m"]].groupby(keys)["value"].sum())
    # FIX: extension-coded parent NI (code suffix AND label must match; label alone is reused for CI attribution)
    ext_np = df[df["std"].isna() & ~df["is_3m"]
                & df["항목코드"].str.contains(r"_(?:ProfitLoss|ProfitLossAttributableToAbstract|"
                                              r"ProfitLossAttributableToOwnersOfParentOfProfitLoss)$")
                & label.str.contains(r"지배") & ~label.str.contains(r"비지배|포괄|계속|중단")].sort_index()
    cand = ext_np.groupby(keys)["value"].first().reindex(out.index)
    cand = cand.where(out["ni"].isna() | (cand.abs() <= 3 * out["ni"].abs() + 1e8))
    out["ni_parent"] = out["ni_parent"].fillna(cand)
    # FIX: extension-coded basic common EPS (applied after ni_parent is final, with a share-count guard)
    eps_lab = label.str.replace(r"[.\-·]", "", regex=True)
    ext_eps = df[df["std"].isna() & ~df["is_3m"]
                 & eps_lab.str.match(r"^(?:보통주)?(?:지배기업(?:의)?소유주(?:지분)?)?(?:귀속)?기본(?:및희석|/희석)?주당"
                                     r"(?:순)?(?:이익|손익|손실|순손익)(?:\(손실\))?$")].sort_index()
    out["eps_ext"] = ext_eps.groupby(keys)["value"].first()
    nci_flow = df[df["std"].eq("ProfitLossAttributableToNoncontrollingInterests")].groupby(keys).size()
    no_nci = ~out.index.isin(nci_flow.index) & out["nci_equity"].isna()
    out.loc[no_nci, "ni_parent"] = out.loc[no_nci, "ni_parent"].fillna(out.loc[no_nci, "ni"])
    out.loc[no_nci, "ni_parent_3m"] = out.loc[no_nci, "ni_parent_3m"].fillna(out.loc[no_nci, "ni_3m"])
    out.loc[no_nci, "equity_parent"] = out.loc[no_nci, "equity_parent"].fillna(out.loc[no_nci, "equity"])
    def _shares_ok(eps):  # filer scale errors: implied share count must be plausible
        sh = out["ni_parent"] / eps.where(eps != 0)
        return sh.between(3e5, 1.5e10) | out["ni_parent"].abs().lt(1e8)
    out["eps_source"] = np.where(out["eps"].notna(), "std", None)
    ext_ok = out["eps_ext"].where(_shares_ok(out["eps_ext"]))
    fill = out["eps"].isna() & ext_ok.notna()
    out.loc[fill, "eps"] = ext_ok[fill]
    out.loc[fill, "eps_source"] = "ext"
    out["eps_suspect"] = out["eps"].notna() & out["ni_parent"].notna() & ~_shares_ok(out["eps"])
    return out.drop(columns="eps_ext").reset_index()


def quarterly_standalone(items: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    order = {"1분기보고서": 1, "반기보고서": 2, "3분기보고서": 3, "사업보고서": 4}
    df = items.copy()
    df["fq"] = df["보고서종류"].map(order)
    df = df.sort_values(["stock_code", "period_end"])
    for f in ["revenue", "op_income", "ni", "ni_parent", "cfo"]:
        q = df[f + "_3m"] if f + "_3m" in df else pd.Series(np.nan, index=df.index)
        prev_ytd = df.groupby("stock_code")[f].shift(1)
        prev_is_q3 = df.groupby("stock_code")["fq"].shift(1).eq(3)
        gap_ok = (df["period_end"] - df.groupby("stock_code")["period_end"].shift(1)).dt.days.between(80, 100)
        q4 = (df[f] - prev_ytd).where(df["fq"].eq(4) & prev_is_q3 & gap_ok)
        prev_fq = df.groupby("stock_code")["fq"].shift(1)                       # FIX: fill from YTD
        q = q.fillna(df[f].where(df["fq"].eq(1)))
        q = q.fillna((df[f] - prev_ytd).where(df["fq"].isin([2, 3]) & prev_fq.eq(df["fq"] - 1) & gap_ok))
        df[f + "_q"] = q.where(df["fq"].lt(4), q4)
        if f == "cfo":
            prev = df.groupby("stock_code")[f].shift(1)
            df["cfo_q"] = np.where(df["fq"].eq(1), df[f], (df[f] - prev).where(gap_ok))
    return df
# Downstream: FX-convert or drop currency != 'KRW'; do not use eps where eps_suspect or for valuation; treat revenue_q < 0 at fq == 4 as NaN.

def next_session_after(d, sessions: pd.DatetimeIndex):
    """First KRX session strictly after calendar date d; NaT if d is missing or after the calendar."""
    if d is None or pd.isna(d):
        return pd.NaT
    d = pd.Timestamp(d).normalize()
    if len(sessions) == 0 or d < sessions[0] - pd.Timedelta(days=7):
        raise ValueError(f"session calendar starts {sessions[0] if len(sessions) else None}, cannot place {d.date()}")
    i = sessions.searchsorted(d, side="right")
    return sessions[i] if i < len(sessions) else pd.NaT

verify.final_recommendation:
Adopt the bulk-values plus receipt-date design, but ship kr_pit_fundamentals_fixed.py (in the verify-kr-fundamentals dir) instead of the prober's module. The original module has three silent value bugs that the prober's validation (12 companies, mostly large and Dec-FY) missed.

(a) Reporting currency is dropped. 34 codes and 919 company-periods are in CNY/USD/JPY/HKD/GBP, including KOSPI 두산밥캣 and 아남전자. FX-convert (period-end rate for balance-sheet items, period-average rate for flows) or exclude them.

(b) Extension-coded parent NI and EPS are missed for whole year runs at large caps (CJ제일제당, 롯데케미칼, NC, 솔브레인, LG전자, 삼성전기). The fixed fallback raises ni_parent coverage from 93.2% to 96.7% and EPS from 94.8% to 96.9%, validated against the next year's standard-coded 전기 values.

(c) The no-NCI fallback wrote ni_parent = ni in 139 rows where the NCI line was extension-coded.

The fixed module also repairs xbrl_key_items, which mixed separate values into consolidated filings (Hyundai FY2018 OP -593억 vs 2.42조), and next_session_after (crashed on NaT; silently misplaced dates before the calendar start).

Keep EPS out of valuation: it is unadjusted, 0.36% of rows have scale errors, and it agrees with WiseReport within 1% only 27% of the time. Compute PER/PBR from market cap and aggregate ni_parent / equity_parent. Treat a negative derived Q4 flow (0.9% of cases) as missing.

Publication dates: the timing numbers reproduce exactly from cache. The +60/+120 fallback was early in 0 of 2,460 periods and 1 of 1,677 filings. The rolled +45/+90 rule is early 1.8 to 3.6% of the time. The naive repo rule is early in 68 to 70% of cases (not 73 to 76%), almost all by exactly one session under the filed-after-close convention; only 1.8 to 3.6% are 2 or more sessions early.

The keyless DART web path is the weakest link. The IP block lasted 43 minutes or more after about 700 requests at 0.5 s spacing, and it also disables the repo's live keyless DART disclosure feature, which runs from the same IP. Get a DART_API_KEY (list.json) before building dates for 3,085 codes. If you must go keyless: at most 10 requests/min, from a different host, resumable, stopping at the first ConnectionError. Until dates are fetched, use the +60/+120 rule and mark those rows as restated, since restatement look-ahead is otherwise unguarded there.
